environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on EKS. Pod spec includes an init container that copies app artifacts to an emptyDir volume. The primary container's rootfs is mounted with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the pod securityContext. No tmpfs, emptyDir, or PVC volumes are mounted at writable paths within /app or /tmp. The container's ephemeral storage request is set to 0 and the node's kubelet is configured with eviction threshold imagefsInodesFree < 5% which prevents any inode allocation. Additionally, the container uses a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/nodejs18-debian11) which lacks shell binaries, crontab, and other system utilities.
